spec.description:
Bradford SoundScreen is Australia's most popular high-density
acoustic insulation batt, specially engineered to reduce sound transfer through
internal walls, external walls, and mid-floors. Manufactured from high-density
FBS-1 bio-soluble glasswool containing up to 65% recycled glass, SoundScreen
absorbs airborne sound and acoustic vibrations to reduce loud noises to a
whisper. It is non-combustible, provides thermal resistance up to R3.1, and is
approved by the National Asthma Council's Sensitive Choice program.
features:
Reduces sound power transfer by up to 75% in interior walls and
mid-floors

High-density glasswool formulation designed specifically for
acoustic absorption

Early

to R3.1 to provide dual thermal-acoustic benefits

Approved by National Asthma
Council Australia's Sensitive Choice program

FBS-1 bio-soluble glasswool
formulation, non-hazardous and safe to handle

Will not pack down, shrink,
mould, rot, or deteriorate

Manufactured in Australia from up to 65% recycled
glass

install:
Friction-fit SoundScreen batts tightly between timber or steel wall framing
studs

Ensure batts completely fill the stud or joist cavity without gaps or
voids around edges

Cut batts neatly around electrical conduits, plumbing
pipes, and junction boxes using an insulation knife

For between-floor
applications, lay batts between mid-floor joists or hold in place before ceiling
lining installation

In party walls or home theatres, pair with acoustic
plasterboard (e.g. Gyprock Soundchek) and resilient mounts for maximum Rw
performance

Fasten internal wall linings directly over the insulated
framework
selection_checklist:
Confirm stud or joist cavity width
(430mm for 450mm centres, 580mm for 600mm centres)

Confirm stud cavity depth
(e.g. 70mm, 75mm, or 90mm stud cavity determines R1.7, R2.0, or R2.5)

Check
required acoustic sound transmission rating (Rw 40 to Rw 55+)

Determine if
thermal R-value is required for external walls or mid-floors
limitations:
Do
not compress batts into cavities narrower than the nominal batt thickness

Acoustic performance depends on airtight wall construction; seal all perimeter
gaps and penetrations

Indoor/enclosed cavity application only; protect from
weather

Friction-fitting into 70mm and 90mm internal stud walls around
bedrooms, bathrooms, and laundries to minimize noise transfer

Mid-floor

Lining home theatre walls and
media rooms paired with acoustic plasterboard for high sound isolation
not_for: Direct floor traffic surfaces or under-tile subfloor underlays
Unlined exposed walls without plasterboard covering

External roofing
applications without waterproof sarking
retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford SoundScreen
Acoustic Batts are high-density, non-combustible glasswool insulation segments
engineered to reduce sound power transfer by up to 75% through internal walls
and mid-floors. Available in thicknesses from 60mm to 110mm (R1.7 to R3.1) with
an acoustic NRC up to 1.15, they absorb conversational noise, television sound,
and plumbing rumble. Certified non-combustible under AS 1530.1 and endorsed by
Sensitive Choice for asthma and allergy sufferers, SoundScreen delivers proven
acoustic privacy and thermal comfort backed by a 70-year warranty.
